topic: Fixing timezone selection failure on traffic page
summary_markdown:
A critical bug was identified where the timezone selector on the Traffic page failed across production, staging, and beta environments. The root cause was determined to be an external injection of a null object into the tags array within a data structure, causing system failure when the system attempted to parse the malformed array.

The issue was resolved by someone, who noted that monitoring performed well and did not trigger alerts during the evening hours.
decisions: The timezone selection bug on the Traffic page is fixed.
